experiment: App1 random-start baseline vs sensitivity initialization
code_vs_reference: no .py differences between HEAD and de5b069 (gn-diag restarts d5eea0e / M5 run cf1ec1d+patch == de5b069); initializer/Src unchanged since 40c9e9e (sensor-layout initializer runs); see env/code_diff_vs_reference_commits.txt (empty diffstat = identical)
excluded: L3 weak layouts (A_L3, B_L3) by design
what_changes_vs_reference: ONLY the initial control: --init-mode manual --initial-control <pre-sampled random start>; plus --max-paraview-frames 1 (export only) and --case-name. Everything else = the reference argv verbatim (config/cases.json common_driver_flags).
fixed_per_case_from_reference: sensor node ids and equal weights w=1
noiseless synthetic data regenerated by the same forward model
mesh_domain box bounds + raw feasibility mode
L-BFGS-B (SciPy) with gn-diag scaling (max ratio 1e4), maxcor 10 (SciPy default; reference post_init.lbfgsb_maxcor = 10), ftol 1e-14, gtol 1e-9, maxls 20 (hard-coded in the driver)
scaling: Gauss-Newton diagonal computed by the driver at EACH random start (production procedure, pio.gn_diagonal_scaling)
sampler: see config/starts.json 'sampler' (area-uniform over the meshed fluid region, no separation restriction, amplitudes U[0.1,2.0])
seeds: seed = 20261114 + 1000*case_index + run_index; case_index 1..5 in case order; run_index 1..10 = the predetermined order for best-of-k curves

recovery_criterion.definition: recovered = all final centers inside the fluid mesh (raw feasibility) AND max matched center error <= 1.0 m AND max matched amplitude error <= 0.01
recovery_criterion.matching: run_optimization.match_sources_by_permutation: label permutation minimizing the TOTAL center position error; amplitude errors taken under that same permutation (the convention of optimization_summary.json recovery_permutation_matched)
recovery_criterion.note: used only for post-hoc reporting; it never stops or alters an optimization. Continuous errors are stored for every run so other thresholds can be applied.

cost_accounting.random_start: scaling/setup = solves inside pio.gn_diagonal_scaling; optimization = rest of the driver's post-init solve_counter block (objective at z0 + L-BFGS-B); reported fwd and adj separately
cost_accounting.sensitivity_reference: initialization (sensitivity initializer phase of the initializer run) + post-init block (GN construction + L-BFGS-B) of the paper run; the GN share is not instrumented in the reference runs, so it is reported inside the post-init block (the random runs measure it directly)
cost_accounting.excluded_from_both_and_reported_separate: data generation (1 forward solve of the true control) and driver output overhead (initial/final state + exports)
cost_accounting.two_source_reference_note: the 2-source paper runs are a chain: sensitivity initializer in sensor_layout_comparison_20261003_151233 (its own unscaled L-BFGS-B polish there is NOT part of the paper pipeline and is excluded) -> gn-diag restart from the saved initialized control in gn_diag_default_check_20261004_161718 (identical start, verified max|dz| = 0)

files.per_run: cases/<run>/{run_result.json, run_instrumentation.json, resolved_driver_args.json, DONE, full/optimization_summary.json, full/optimization_history.csv}
